message: `in: query` parameter "objectWithMapping" has a schema that is the discriminated union "ObjectWithMapping". Discriminated unions are not valid types for query parameters. Fern imports a oneOf/anyOf as a discriminated union when it has a `discriminator.mapping` or when each member has a distinct single-value string `enum`/`const` in the same property; on a oneOf, `x-fern-discriminated: false` imports it as an undiscriminated union instead.

`in: query` parameter "objectUndiscriminated" has a schema that is the discriminated union "ObjectUndiscriminated". Discriminated unions are not valid types for query parameters. Fern imports a oneOf/anyOf as a discriminated union when it has a `discriminator.mapping` or when each member has a distinct single-value string `enum`/`const` in the same property; on a oneOf, `x-fern-discriminated: false` imports it as an undiscriminated union instead.
